substrate_classes.description: Tau checks bounded policy, admission, and host-fact composition rules after the runtime supplies and binds the facts.
A full node can recompute the transition from public inputs and replay artifacts.
A verifier can check a proof whose public inputs bind the pre-state root, post-state root, transition batch root, profile id, and public data root.
A light-client checkpoint replay or quorum lane binds headers and signatures, but does not prove every value-moving transition.
Proof metadata and report replay can enforce fail-closed proof profiles, but cannot by itself prove zkVM execution.
A proof-required profile rejects unsupported, missing, or mismatched proofs before admission.
Oracle truth, validator rotation, fork choice, and open-network finality require evidence outside a Tau policy check.

proof_gap_obligations.tau_scope: UPBA bounded-grid clearing and exact-out optimality are arithmetic certificate and state-transition obligations, not Tau guard obligations in the current surface.
proof_gap_obligations.missing_proof: Real zkVM execution proof for UPBA v2/v3 batch clearing, exact-out, candidate-root binding, and fill-vector-root binding.
limits: Tau does not prove candidate-grid optimality or state-root transition execution.
The current authority is deterministic replay until the zkVM lane exists.

proof_gap_obligations.tau_scope: Tau can check freshness and guard composition over host-projected oracle facts. It cannot prove live oracle truth, quorum honesty, governance, or the state transition authorized by the oracle packet.
proof_gap_obligations.missing_proof: Real proof for critical-action packet verification and the value-moving transition authorized by the packet; external oracle truth remains a separate assumption or proof lane.
limits: Tau guard coverage is useful admission evidence only.
Oracle truth and governance remain outside Tau unless reduced to separately bound facts.

proof_gap_obligations.tau_scope: Tau covers selected zUSD lifecycle and oracle-recovery guards over projected facts. It does not prove mint, repay, redeem, liquidation, stability-pool, or supply-root transitions.
proof_gap_obligations.missing_proof: Real zkVM execution proof for zUSD mint, repay, redeem, liquidation, recovery, stability-pool claim, and supply-conservation state transitions.
limits: Tau guard checks do not prove supply conservation by themselves.
The current zUSD authority remains deterministic replay for scoped full-node validation.

proof_gap_obligations.tau_scope: Tau covers perps ingress schema and stream guards over projected authorization facts. It does not prove funding, liquidation, ADL, insurance, or settlement account transitions.
proof_gap_obligations.missing_proof: Real zkVM execution proof for perps settlement, liquidation, ADL, funding, insurance, account-root, and market-root transitions.
limits: Tau ingress evidence can block malformed requests before execution.
Perps value movement still requires replay or a zkVM execution proof.

proof_gap_obligations.tau_scope: Tau can cover reward claimability and payout-template guard facts. It does not prove reward-pool debits, payout bridge execution, or manager state-root transitions.
proof_gap_obligations.missing_proof: Real zkVM execution proof for proof-mining claimability, reward payout execution, reward-pool accounting, and manager state transitions.
limits: Tau reward guards are admission evidence only.
Reward balances and transfer effects still need replay or zkVM execution proof.

proof_gap_obligations.tau_scope: Recursive receipt aggregation is proof-system evidence. Tau can gate metadata policy. It cannot produce or verify the recursive proof soundness claim by itself.
proof_gap_obligations.missing_proof: Real recursive receipt aggregation proof with child-proof, journal-root, and epoch-header binding.
limits: Metadata replay can reject missing or mismatched proof reports.
Metadata replay does not prove recursive aggregation soundness.

proof_gap_obligations.tau_scope: Tau can express dispute-window and finality-admission guards over projected epoch and challenge facts. It cannot prove BLS soundness, fork choice, validator rotation, slashing, peer discovery, or open-network finality.
proof_gap_obligations.missing_proof: Production validator rotation, fork-choice, slashing, peer-discovery, and adversarial-network finality evidence beyond the current local checkpoint replay.
limits: Tau finality guards can help admission policy.
Open-network finality remains an external consensus obligation.

unsupported_proof_required_family_obliga.missing_proof: Spot v1 zkVM rejected-receipt execution and non-mutation proof.
limits: The current proof-required profile rejects this family fail-closed.
Tau rejection predicates would still need runtime fact binding and state non-mutation evidence.

unsupported_proof_required_family_obliga.missing_proof: Spot v1 zkVM exact-out execution proof.
limits: Exact-out remains admitted through deterministic replay and UPBA certificate lanes.
The current spot v1 proof profile must reject exact-out proof admission.

unsupported_proof_required_family_obliga.missing_proof: Spot v1 zkVM UPBA batch-clearing execution proof.
limits: UPBA remains deterministic certificate replay plus an open real-proof gap.
The current spot v1 proof profile must reject UPBA proof admission.

unsupported_proof_required_family_obliga.missing_proof: Spot v1 zkVM multi-hop execution proof.
limits: Multi-hop proof execution is not admitted under the current spot v1 proof profile.
Tau route guards cannot prove hop-by-hop state-root transitions.

unsupported_proof_required_family_obliga.missing_proof: Spot v1 zkVM native-asset synchronization proof with external asset-root binding.
limits: Native asset sync remains outside the current spot proof profile.
Tau cannot prove external asset custody or synchronization state by itself.
